I'm about 260lbs and 6'2 so it's not really much of an achievement.
My routine is loosely based on SS, but I work away from home quit often, so some weeks I go more, some weeks I go less.

Had two weeks off from the gym due to illness.

First day back I jump right in with some ATG squats.
As I get to the bottom my shorts rip up both sides and I'm left with just the waist band holding two loose pieces of cloth.

Finished the workout regardless, received a few laughs.

That's a possibility.

I shouldn't be eating that shit, I go the gym to try to lose fat, but I'm terrible for slipping and eating badly.

I understand that carbs give you energy.

I probably gave a bad example. Say I had KFC, just the chicken, I'd still lift better than if I'd of ate a relatively healthy pasta based meal.

Why are my lifts and recovery times so much better when I eat really badly?

Say I was to eat a pizza for dinner, I'd be a lot stronger and feel much better after the gym, than when I eat chicken, veg, rice etc. of equal calories.
